A '''Human male''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]. He flew with the legendary [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]], led by [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was one of three pilots that Phennir brought to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] on a diplomatic mission to convince the government of the nation state of [[Cartann]] to join the Empire. Four [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] pilots were also in [[Cartann City]], arguing the New Republic's case.

While staying in Cartann, the Imperial pilots daily engaged local pilots in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|aerial duels]] to the [[Death/Legends|death]]. Racking up many kills, they gained considerable honor, in accordance with local customs. During their [[Time/Legends|time]] on-world, Cartann declared [[Adumari Civil War|war]] on the other nations of Adumar. The Imperials fought for them when forces of the [[Yedagon Confederacy]] attacked Cartann. The New Republic pilots flew with the Confederacy, and the Human male was the third Imperial pilot to die, his [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptor]] brought down by a [[Laser/Legends|laser]] salvo from [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]].

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]'', one of Phennir's men is described as being a tall, [[Color/Legends|red]]-[[Hair/Legends|headed]] man. It is unclear if that man is the pilot described in this article or one of the [[Unidentified 181st pilot|two]] [[Unidentified 181st pilot 2|other]] men on Phennir's ambassadorial team.
